fix.summary: 修订 issue #78 的两处旧版残留：User Story 10 必须改为 D4e 的目录名键及其明确接受的改名分簿/撞名并簿语义，不得继续承诺根提交指纹与改名不裂账；Further Notes 的“本 spec r2”改为当前 r3。其余终版材料无需改动。

classes.name: D4c identity promise remains in User Story 10
classes.owner: Issue #78 public identity contract / ADR 0048 boundary
classes.boundary: User Stories §10 versus Solution and Implementation Decisions D4e clauses
classes.disposition: AMEND. Story 10 currently says “按根提交指纹分簿” and promises “改名…在构造上裂不了账”. That is the superseded D4c mechanism and a stronger robustness promise than D4e, which expressly allows directory renames to split books and same-name projects to merge. Replace the story with the selected common-dir-host basename behavior and its accepted cosmetic split/merge limits.

classes.name: Revision label remains at r2
classes.disposition: AMEND. Change “本 spec r2” to “本 spec r3”; this is stale package identification, not a new authority decision.

arguments.note: Non-blocking dispositions: D1a/D2b/D3a, git-only refusal, and the no-registry/no-marker/no-identity-fingerprint/no-label-map boundary are otherwise stated consistently. The “引用指纹” in Story 8 and packet-path digest in Implementation Decisions are dispatch-reference digests authorized by the prior round, not book identity. ADR 0049 contains the required provenance-facet qualification (“session 只对誊本内容是正本；每条派发/激活事实以产生它的那一面为正本”). ADRs 0047–0049 are short, decision-focused, and corpus-consistent. No owner fork remains.

evidence.currentSpec: `gh issue view 78 --repo Akagilnc/ak-pi-workflow-roles --json ...` returned the current r3 body; User Story 10 still contains the superseded root-commit wording while Solution and Implementation Decisions specify D4e and reject fingerprint layers.
evidence.emptyRepoProbe: A fresh zero-commit `git init` reported absolute common dir `<tmp>/fresh-empty/.git`; its host-directory basename was `fresh-empty`, while `HEAD` was unborn. Thus the former empty-repo/blank-key blocker is genuinely mooted.
evidence.adr0048: Defines key as basename of the git common dir host directory, folds worktrees to the main repository name, loudly refuses non-git ignition, and expressly accepts rename splits/name-collision merges.
evidence.adr0049: Qualifies canonical provenance by facet and retains zero content bytes/excerpts.
